description: TI TPS563201 / TPS563208, 4.5 V to 17 V input, 3 A synchronous step-down (buck) converter in SOT-23, D-CAP2 mode control, 580 kHz quasi-fixed switching frequency, internal 1.0 ms soft start, pre-biased start-up, cycle-by-cycle OCL with hiccup, non-latching UVP and TSD. TPS563201 is the pulse-skipping (Eco-mode) variant; TPS563208 is forced-CCM. Datasheet ZHCSEL2 (Chinese-language edition of SLVSD90), December 2015, 24 pages; body sections 5-10 are in English. FEEDBACK REFERENCE CONFIRMED: VFB threshold 768 mV typ (749 mV min / 787 mV max) in continuous-conduction mode, and 774 mV in Eco-mode at VO = 1.05 V / IO = 10 mA. Equation 2 of the datasheet is VOUT = 0.768 x (1 + R1/R2). Maximum recommended operating duty cycle 75%, so minimum recommended VIN = VO / 0.75.

pinout.name: GND
pinout.notes: Ground pin. Source terminal of the low-side power NFET as well as the ground terminal for the controller circuit. Datasheet: 'Connect sensitive VFB to this GND at a single point.'

pinout.name: SW
pinout.notes: Switch node connection between the high-side NFET and the low-side NFET. Datasheet I/O column: O.

pinout.name: VIN
pinout.notes: Input voltage supply pin; the drain terminal of the high-side power NFET. Datasheet I/O column: I.

pinout.name: VFB
pinout.notes: Converter feedback input. Connect to output voltage with a feedback resistor divider. VFB threshold 768 mV typ (749/787) in CCM. VFB input current 0 typ / +/-0.1 uA max at VFB = 0.8 V.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.notes: Enable input control. Active high and must be pulled up to enable the device. VENH 1.6 V (high-level input voltage), VENL 0.8 V (low-level input voltage). EN pin resistance to GND 225 / 400 / 900 kohm (min/typ/max) at VEN = 12 V, so EN can be biased from VIN with a series resistor.

pinout.name: VBST
pinout.notes: Supply input for the high-side NFET gate-drive circuit. Datasheet I/O column: O. Connect a 0.1 uF capacitor between VBST and SW pins.

decoupling.placement: as close to the device as possible; VIN to GND
decoupling.notes: Section 8.2.2.3: 'The TPS563201 and TPS563208 require an input decoupling capacitor and a bulk capacitor is needed depending on the application. TI recommends a ceramic capacitor over 10 uF for the decoupling capacitor.' Capacitor voltage rating must be greater than the maximum input voltage. Reference design Figure 19 uses C1 10 uF + C2 10 uF.
Section 8.2.2.3: 'An additional 0.1-uF capacitor (C3) from pin 3 to ground is optional to provide additional high frequency filtering.'
Section 8.2.2.4: 'A 0.1-uF ceramic capacitor must be connected between the VBST to SW pin for proper operation. TI recommends to use a ceramic capacitor.' Not optional.

decoupling.value: output capacitance 20 uF to 68 uF total (VOUT to GND)
decoupling.placement: as close to the device as possible; provide sufficient vias
decoupling.notes: Section 8.2.2.2 / Table 2: recommended output capacitance range is 20 uF to 68 uF for every listed output voltage including 3.3 V. Intended for ceramic or other low-ESR capacitors; D-CAP2 needs no external compensation. Reference design uses 2 x 22 uF ceramic (TDK C3216X5R0J226M, ESR ~2 mohm each, 4 A rating each).

land_pattern.package: DDC (R-PDSO-G6), SOT-23-THIN, JEDEC MO-193 variation AA (6 pin)
land_pattern.notes: This datasheet contains only the MECHANICAL DATA package outline (drawing 4204403-3/E 06/05); it publishes NO recommended land pattern, so no pad size is transcribed here. Package outline values: lead pitch 0.95 (basic); lead width 0.30 to 0.50 with 0.20 (M) positional tolerance; lead span across rows 2.55 to 3.05; body length 2.75 to 3.05; body width 1.45 to 1.75; body height 1.10 max; standoff 0.00 to 0.10; lead thickness 0.12 to 0.20; foot length 0.25 (gauge plane) with 0.30 to 0.60 detail; lead foot angle 0 to 8 deg. Pin order top view: 1 GND, 2 SW, 3 VIN on the bottom row (left to right) and 6 VBST, 5 EN, 4 VFB on the top row (left to right). Pin 1 index area is at the lower-left of the top view.

layout_notes: VIN and GND traces should be as wide as possible to reduce trace impedance. The wide areas are also an advantage from the point of view of heat dissipation.
The input capacitor and output capacitor should be placed as close to the device as possible to minimize trace impedance.
Provide sufficient vias for the input capacitor and output capacitor.
Keep the SW trace as physically short and wide as practical to minimize radiated emissions.
Do not allow switching current to flow under the device.
A separate VOUT path should be connected to the upper feedback resistor.
Make a Kelvin connection to the GND pin for the feedback path.
The voltage feedback loop should be placed away from the high-voltage switching trace, and preferably has a ground shield.
The trace of the VFB node should be as small as possible to avoid noise coupling.
The GND trace between the output capacitor and the GND pin should be as wide as possible to minimize its trace impedance.

Layout example (Figure 36) shows the SW node as a copper pour area on an internal or bottom layer reached by vias, feedback resistors placed near the VFB pin away from SW, and additional vias to the GND plane around the input bypass capacitor.
Thermal (section 6.4, DDC 6-pin): RthJA 92.6 C/W, RthJC(top) 48.5 C/W, RthJB 15.5 C/W, psiJT 2.5 C/W, psiJB 15.5 C/W.
